(data source schema)
    description: Coralogix webhook. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/coralogix-Webhook-extension/.
custom  nested SINGLE computed
    description: Generic webhook.
custom.headers  tftypes.Map[tftypes.String] computed
    description: Webhook headers. Map of string to string. A header carrying a secret belongs in `headers_wo` instead, so its value is never written to state.
custom.headers_wo  tftypes.Map[tftypes.String] computed
    description: Webhook headers whose values are secret, keyed by header name. Values are sent to Coralogix and never written to state. Every key needs a matching entry in `headers_wo_versions`, and a key here must not also appear in `headers`. Terraform never stores a write-only value, so it cannot detect that the secret changed: increment `headers_wo_versions` to send a rotated one. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later. Importing brings the value into state, because an import has neither configuration nor prior state to say the value is managed this way; one apply afterwards removes it again, so treat an imported secret as exposed and rotate it. Reading the same webhook through `data.coralogix_webhook` does return this value, because a data source reads from the API and has no configuration telling it which value is managed write-only.
custom.headers_wo_versions  tftypes.Map[tftypes.Number] computed
    description: Version of each `headers_wo` value, keyed by header name. Increment a header's version to send a rotated secret.
custom.method  tftypes.String computed
    description: Webhook method. can be one of: get, post, put
custom.payload  tftypes.String computed
    description: Webhook payload. JSON string.
custom.url  tftypes.String computed
    description: Webhook URL.
custom.uuid  tftypes.String computed
    description: Webhook UUID. Computed automatically.
demisto  nested SINGLE computed
    description: Demisto webhook.
demisto.payload  tftypes.String computed
    description: Webhook payload. JSON string.
demisto.url  tftypes.String computed
    description: Microsoft Teams URL.
demisto.uuid  tftypes.String computed
    description: Webhook UUID. Computed automatically.
email_group  nested SINGLE computed
    description: Email group webhook.
email_group.emails  tftypes.List[tftypes.String] computed
    description: Emails list.
event_bridge  nested SINGLE computed
event_bridge.detail  tftypes.String computed
    description: Event bridge message. JSON string. More details about the token ["here"](https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/alerting/outbound-webhooks/generic-outbound-webhooks-alert-webhooks/#placeholders)
event_bridge.detail_type  tftypes.String computed
    description: Free text to be included in the event.
event_bridge.event_bus_arn  tftypes.String computed
    description: Corresponds to the event bus, which will receive notifications. The policy attached must contain permission to publish.
event_bridge.role_name  tftypes.String computed
    description: Corresponds to the AWS IAM role that will be created in your account.
event_bridge.source  tftypes.String computed
    description: Free text is used to identify the messages Coralogix sends.
external_id  tftypes.String computed
    description: Webhook external ID. Using to linq webhook to alert.
id  tftypes.String optional
    description: Webhook ID.
jira  nested SINGLE computed
    description: Jira webhook.
jira.api_token  tftypes.String computed
    description: Jira API token. Use `api_token_wo` instead to keep it out of state.
jira.api_token_wo  tftypes.String computed
    description: Jira API token, sent to Coralogix and never written to state. Terraform never stores a write-only value, so it cannot detect that the secret changed: increment `api_token_wo_version` to send a rotated one. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later. Importing brings the value into state, because an import has neither configuration nor prior state to say the value is managed this way; one apply afterwards removes it again, so treat an imported secret as exposed and rotate it. Reading the same webhook through `data.coralogix_webhook` does return this value, because a data source reads from the API and has no configuration telling it which value is managed write-only.
jira.api_token_wo_version  tftypes.Number computed
    description: Version of `api_token_wo`. Increment it to send a rotated API token.
jira.email  tftypes.String computed
    description: email.
jira.project_key  tftypes.String computed
    description: Jira project key.
jira.url  tftypes.String computed
    description: Jira URL.
microsoft_teams  nested SINGLE computed
    description: Microsoft Teams webhook. (Deprecated, please use microsoft_teams_workflow)
microsoft_teams.url  tftypes.String computed
    description: Microsoft Teams URL.
microsoft_teams_workflow  nested SINGLE computed
    description: Microsoft Teams Workflow webhook.
microsoft_teams_workflow.url  tftypes.String computed
    description: Microsoft Teams Workflow URL.
name  tftypes.String optional,computed
    description: Webhook name.
opsgenie  nested SINGLE computed
    description: Opsgenie webhook.
opsgenie.url  tftypes.String computed
    description: Opsgenie URL.
pager_duty  nested SINGLE computed
    description: PagerDuty webhook.
pager_duty.service_key  tftypes.String computed
    description: PagerDuty service key. Use `service_key_wo` instead to keep it out of state.
pager_duty.service_key_wo  tftypes.String computed
    description: PagerDuty service key, sent to Coralogix and never written to state. Terraform never stores a write-only value, so it cannot detect that the secret changed: increment `service_key_wo_version` to send a rotated one. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later. Importing brings the value into state, because an import has neither configuration nor prior state to say the value is managed this way; one apply afterwards removes it again, so treat an imported secret as exposed and rotate it. Reading the same webhook through `data.coralogix_webhook` does return this value, because a data source reads from the API and has no configuration telling it which value is managed write-only.
pager_duty.service_key_wo_version  tftypes.Number computed
    description: Version of `service_key_wo`. Increment it to send a rotated service key.
sendlog  nested SINGLE computed
    description: Send log webhook.
sendlog.payload  tftypes.String computed
    description: Webhook payload. JSON string.
sendlog.url  tftypes.String computed
    description: Webhook URL returned by the service when present. SendLog webhooks do not support configuring a URL.
sendlog.uuid  tftypes.String computed
    description: Webhook UUID. Computed automatically.
slack  nested SINGLE computed
    description: Slack webhook.
slack.attachments  nested LIST computed
    description: Slack attachments.
slack.attachments.active  tftypes.Bool computed
    description: Determines if the attachment is active. Default is true.
slack.attachments.type  tftypes.String computed
    description: Slack attachment type. can be one of: empty, logs, metric_snapshot
slack.notify_on  tftypes.Set[tftypes.String] computed
    description: Slack notifications. can be one of: data_usage, error_and_critical_logs, flow_anomalies, spike_anomalies
slack.url  tftypes.String computed
    description: Slack URL.
